# bcdec

Unmodified `bcdec.h` and `LICENSE` from
[iOrange/bcdec](https://github.com/iOrange/bcdec), commit
`80859ed3b7afb1c527a2a99d70c61457bea72d0c` (version 0.985).

Used by the offline diffuse baker to evaluate the BC7 base colour, metallic and
emissive textures produced by model ingest. The runtime does not decompress these
textures. Licensed under the MIT option in the accompanying dual licence.
